task.name: Strike_camp_furniture
task.when: During Strike after common and public areas close

step.action: Remove cushions and put each dry set in its assigned clear storage bag.
Fold and stack the chairs by type.
Roll each clean, dry rug and secure the roll.
Dismantle each Playatech bench and swing in its printed reverse sequence.
Put each furniture group's hardware in its assigned hardware bin.
Stack or pack each furniture group in the location shown in 📦 Build_Book.

passWhen.criterion: Every cushion, chair, rug, bench, swing, and hardware piece is accounted for.
Soft items are clean, dry, and protected from dust and moisture.
Furniture groups are packed by type.
The former furniture areas are clear and MOOP-free.
